basic_details.job_title: MbPA Facility Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) is engaging 11 Facility Managers as Young Professionals in its Medical Department, purely on contract basis, at a consolidated remuneration of Rs 50,000 per month. The application has to be made offline in the prescribed format and sent to the Establishment Section, Medical Department, MbPA Hospital, Nadkarni Park, Wadala (East), Mumbai - 400 037, where it must be received by 14 December 2026. Applicants need a first-class Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and a first-class MBA, and must be less than 35 years of age.

qualification.details: All 11 vacancies are for one post, Facility Manager as Young Professional, engaged purely on contract and on a full-time basis. Where the mark sheet shows CGPA, the candidate must convert it into an accurate percentage using the criteria of the university or institution concerned. | Good communication skills Experience in hospitality services Fluent in English, Hindi and Marathi languages | Eager to learn and work with various departments/divisions Excellent verbal and written communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Ability to multitask and cope well under pressure Strong data modelling, research and analytical skills | Consolidated remuneration of Rs 50,000/- per month, paid on certification of work and attendance by the Head of Division under whom the professional is posted. Annual increment of 5% on the last drawn remuneration, based on satisfactory performance. No allowances of any kind, such as Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, transport facility, personal staff, CGHS or medical reimbursement. No TA/DA for joining or completing the assignment; travel needed for work is compensated as per MbPA norms at the time of travel. TDS as admissible is deducted from the monthly remuneration; a TDS certificate is issued by the Medical Department on demand. Provisions of the Code on Social Security, 2020 apply.

selection_process: Applications received will be scrutinised and shortlisted in the light of each candidate's qualification

experience and other details given in the application form. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a test/interview etc. before selection. Meeting the qualification or being shortlisted does not confer any right to be engaged. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in a written examination or interview
The selected candidate must produce original mark sheets
a character certificate and a Self Declaration Certificate at the time of joining
failing which the candidature will be cancelled. Selected candidates who are employed (Government
autonomous bodies or private sector) must submit a discharge or relieving letter at joining
without which they will not be allowed to join. Engagement is subject to medical fitness as per MbPA requirements and to police verification of antecedents.
important_instructions: The initial engagement is for 2 years, extendable by another 2 years on performance, with no further extension. Performance is reviewed every 6 months, with a one working day break. A fresh Integrity Pact must be submitted before engagement and before each renewal; no other assignment may be taken up during the engagement. Leave: 20 days Casual Leave per calendar year on a pro-rata basis; absence beyond this leads to deductions, and absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave may lead to termination. Unused leave is neither carried forward nor encashed. MbPA quarters can be provided subject to availability, at a rent of 10% of the consolidated remuneration plus licence fees, with electricity and water charged on actual consumption and a security deposit of two months' rent, refundable after a No Dues Certificate from the Chief Medical Officer. OPD and IPD treatment with medicine is provided at MbPA Hospital/Dispensary; there is no outside referral and no medical facility for family or dependants. Facility Managers must have their own laptops; MbPA provides working space and internet. A 1-2 week orientation training is given. A completion certificate is issued by the Medical Department; no experience certificate is issued for less than 1 year of engagement or for unsatisfactory attendance. MbPA may end the engagement at any time with one month's notice or remuneration in lieu, or forthwith for unsatisfactory work, lack of integrity, an adverse police report or false credentials; the Facility Manager must give one month's notice to leave. A candidate can apply only once in a financial year. Canvassing in any form disqualifies, and updates or corrigenda appear only on www.mumbaiport.gov.in under People & Career > Jobs.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted offline only, in the format given on the MbPA website. The notice sets out these steps: The notice does not name a particular postal mode such as speed post or registered post. It states that resumes or CVs sent alone, and incomplete applications, are liable to be rejected, and that applications received after the due date are liable to be rejected. MbPA takes no responsibility if a candidate is unable to submit the application by the last date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 11 vacancies are for one post, Facility Manager as Young Professional, engaged purely on contract and on a full-time basis. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up. Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with first class, and Master of Business Administration with First Class. Applicants must state the percentage of marks in the application form. Where the mark sheet shows CGPA, the candidate must convert it into an accurate percentage using the criteria of the university or institution concerned. Good communication skills Experience in hospitality services Fluent in English, Hindi and Marathi languages Eager to learn and work with various departments/divisions Excellent verbal and written communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Ability to multitask and cope well under pressure Strong data modelling, research and analytical skills Consolidated remuneration of Rs 50,000/- per month, paid on certification of work and attendance by the Head of Division under whom the professional is posted. Annual increment of 5% on the last drawn remuneration, based on satisfactory performance. No allowances of any kind, such as Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, transport facility, personal staff, CGHS or medical reimbursement. No TA/DA for joining or completing the assignment; travel needed for work is compensated as per MbPA norms at the time of travel. TDS as admissible is deducted from the monthly remuneration; a TDS certificate is issued by the Medical Department on demand. Provisions of the Code on Social Security, 2020 apply.

content_sections.heading: MbPA Facility Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The 11 Facility Managers will work on a rotational basis in shifts, on all days. Their duties and responsibilities, as printed, are: Patient guidance and facilitation services Front office and enquiry desk management Coordination of ambulance and other transport services Management of accommodation facilities for patient relatives Monitoring of diet kitchen, pantries and canteen services Supervision of OPD, IPD, Linen, CSSD and Housekeeping related facility issues Coordination with Civil Engineering and MEED Departments for maintenance requirements Monitoring cleanliness, hygiene, infection control and safety standards Management of Hospital Campus facilities and residential quarters Protocol arrangements for visiting dignitaries and senior officers Any other work assigned by CMO/Sr. Dy. CMO (Admin) Working hours are normally an eight-hour shift as decided by the Chief Medical Officer / Sr. Dy. CMO (Admin). In exigencies, staff may have to sit late or attend on office holidays without other compensation, and duty hours may be extended as work requires. The weekly day of rest may be changed with prior intimation; work on a weekly off or declared public holiday earns a compensatory day of rest only.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of these documents must be sent with the application, and the originals must be produced for verification at the interview: Proof of age: Birth Certificate, School Leaving Certificate, Age & Nationality Certificate or any other certificate issued by an educational institute (PAN and Aadhaar Card are not accepted as proof of date of birth) Matriculation (X) mark sheet Intermediate (XII) mark sheet All mark sheets of the degree, and the degree certificate All mark sheets of the MBA, and the MBA degree certificate Experience certificate, if any Candidates serving in Government, Semi-Government, Public Sector Undertakings or autonomous bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer with the application, failing which their candidature may not be considered. The application form also asks for a passport-size photograph, contact details of two references (email and mobile number) and documents supporting any outstanding achievement mentioned.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinised and shortlisted in the light of each candidate's qualification, experience and other details given in the application form. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a test/interview etc. before selection. Meeting the qualification or being shortlisted does not confer any right to be engaged. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in a written examination or interview, if called. The selected candidate must produce original mark sheets, a character certificate and a Self Declaration Certificate at the time of joining, failing which the candidature will be cancelled. Selected candidates who are employed (Government, Semi-Government, Public Sector, autonomous bodies or private sector) must submit a discharge or relieving letter at joining, without which they will not be allowed to join. Engagement is subject to medical fitness as per MbPA requirements and to police verification of antecedents.

faq.question: Q1. How many Facility Manager vacancies has MbPA announced?
faq.answer: Mumbai Port Authority will engage 11 Facility Managers as Young Professionals in its Medical Department, purely on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the MbPA Facility Manager application?
faq.answer: The application must be received at MbPA Hospital, Wadala (East), Mumbai on or before 14 December 2026, the last date for receipt.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for MbPA Facility Manager?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with first class and a Master of Business Administration with First Class. Hospitality experience and fluency in English, Hindi and Marathi are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MbPA Facility Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates should be less than 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement; the notice fixes 01.12.2026 as the crucial date for determining eligibility.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an MbPA Facility Manager?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs 50,000 per month, with an annual increment of 5% on the last drawn remuneration based on satisfactory performance. No allowances such as DA, HRA or transport allowance are paid.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MbPA Facility Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the Annexure I format from www.mumbaiport.gov.in, fill it in, attach self-attested documents and send it to Establishment Section, Medical Department, MbPA Hospital, Nadkarni Park, Wadala (East), Mumbai - 400 037, by 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed "Application for engagement of Facility Manager as Young Professionals on Purely Contract Basis".

faq.question: Q8. How will MbPA select Facility Managers?
faq.answer: Applications will be scrutinised and shortlisted on qualification, experience and other details in the application form, and shortlisted candidates may be called for a test/interview etc.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MbPA Facility Manager job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely contractual, full-time engagement for an initial 2 years, extendable by 2 more years on performance, with no further extension.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply more than once?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that a candidate can apply for engagement only once during a financial year.
